name: claude-sdlc-skills
description: AI-native SDLC skills for Claude Code and other coding agents: requirement intake & audit, technical design, AI test orchestration, adversarial review gate, in-flight decision review, design-to-code visual restoration, pre-release audit, write-time guardrail enforcement, artifact sync to team platform.

plugins.name: sdlc-skills
plugins.description: Nine battle-tested SDLC skills: sdlc-intent (PRD digest + seven-layer audit + A/B/C risk tiering), sdlc-design (technical design doc: alternatives, tiered interface contracts, shared-asset ownership, C/H decisions, slicing constraints), sdlc-test (cases/dev/static/exec/spec/report with human checkpoints), sdlc-gate (risk-tiered adversarial review gate: 4/2 fresh-context subagents or main-session self-check, plus guard_dev), sdlc-doubt (adversarial re-check of non-trivial decisions), sdlc-ui-visual (design-to-code visual restoration via real browser screenshots: DOM geometry + pixel heatmap + small-element inspection, tiered fix rounds, functional regression), sdlc-release-check (pre-release audit: Apollo/Nacos keys, xxl-job/MQ registrations, DDL/DML grading, release runbook), sdlc-guardrails (write-time red-line engine: PostToolUse hook + pre-commit + baseline scan), sdlc-sync (artifact sync bridge between local markdown and the team-facing platform).
